name: AiGS Act 1 - Onboarding Orchestrator (copy with form awesome)

values.content: =Read the attached signed contract and return ONLY valid JSON with these exact keys: client_name, contract_value (number, no symbols or commas), contract_signed_at (YYYY-MM-DD), go_live_date (YYYY-MM-DD), services (array of codes chosen ONLY from this list: {{ ({'EVENTS':'SHUTTLE, VENUE, CATERING, STAFFING, AV','MANUFACTURING':'QUALITY_AUDIT, LOGISTICS, TOOLING, CERTIFICATION','HEALTHCARE':'CREDENTIALING, PAYER_ENROLLMENT, BACKGROUND_CHECK, EMR_PROVISIONING','PROF_SERVICES':'CONFLICT_CHECK, BILLING_SETUP, STAFFING, COMPLIANCE_REVIEW'})[$('Normalize Submission').first().json.industry] }}). Include a service code only if the contract obliges the provider to deliver that service. The monetary amount appears in the Fees section written both in words and in figures; return the figure as a plain number.

parameters.formTitle: Onboard a new client in 90 seconds
parameters.formDescription: Tell us about your world. We'll run a real onboarding — with your industry's vocabulary — on the screen in front of you.

values.fieldLabel: Which is closest to your world?
Honestly — how many days does onboarding a new client take your team today?

nodes.name: Came From the Form?
nodes.notes: The CTA page is only meaningful for a real attendee on a phone. The webhook path (verify-act1.sh, verify-all-industries.sh, the Task 13 load test) has no form context, and a Form node there would break Act 1 -- the one thing in this demo that must not break.

nodes.name: CTA Page
nodes.notes: Their own estimate, in 56px, against the 90 seconds they just watched. That contrast is the close -- do not replace it with a generic thank-you. The button href is a mailto fallback until the calendar link is supplied; see STATUS.md open items.

nodes.name: Webhook Response
nodes.notes: Passthrough, and load bearing. responseMode lastNode + firstEntryJson returns the last node's FIRST output branch. If the chain ends on an IF's false output, branch 0 is empty and every webhook caller gets {} -- which took verify-all-industries.sh from 4/4 to 0/4. Ending the false path here keeps the last node single-output.
